The most distinguishing features — **sunken circular lesions with concentric rings on ripe fruit** — are the hallmark of **Anthracnose**. The dark spots with ring patterns visible on the orange fruit strongly match Anthracnose (Colletotrichum phomoides), which is one of the most common post-harvest diseases of tomato affecting ripe fruits.
